BOTH CLASSES ARE EAGER over the import, so a substrate defect kills EVERY importer that

through the import alone.  The `no-import` column is the cell that can catch a reader
which resolves the def against the WHOLE TREE instead of the closure: that reader would
report this file dead too, and it is not.

targets SEQUENTIALLY, so the blast radius of a substrate edit is
    the number of lanes whose TURN FALLS INSIDE THE EDIT'S WINDOW,
and the recorded target order shows the window: the four deaths are at indices 45, 46,
47 and 49 of 50, with index 48 (`uop/weak.bend`) NOT-STARTED so no lane ran there at all.
